      Dividend Policy                                                  股息政策
      The Group is committed to sharing its development and            本集團致力於透過積極穩健及可持續的派息政
      achievements with Shareholders through proactive, stable and     策，努力在短期的股息回報與長期的公司發展
      sustainable dividend policy. The Group would strive to strike    之間達致平衡，與股東共同分享本集團的發展
      a balance between the short-term dividend returns and long-      和成就。在考慮派息政策時，本集團將綜合觀
      term development of the Group prudently. When considering        察宏觀經濟運行情況、行業競爭格局以及自身
      the dividend policy, the Group will comprehensively observe      發展戰略，在確保本集團具備充足營運資金和
      the macro-economic operation, the competition pattern of         資本性開支以落實發展戰略的前提下，將盈餘
      the industry and the Group’s own development strategy.           資金派發給股東，回報股東的支持。
      Under the premise of ensuring that the Group has sufficient
      working capital and capital expenditure to implement the
      development strategy, the Group will distribute surplus funds
